rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.0003, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-7 ONE-KNOB: warm-start pretrain_epochs 6->8 at the lr=3e-4 WINNER base (lr=3e-4, n_iter=400, unet_c=16, val_n=4, grad_clip=1.0 all HELD at the iter-6 winning baseline). FAILURE MODE / WHAT WE LEARNED across iters 1-6: (a) optimization budget is saturated (n_iter 400->800: 0.9501->0.9508 marginal, iter-2); (b) capacity is flat (unet_c 16->32: NO gain, iter-3, and campaign-state confirms mayo c16->c32 flat at 0.9508 -- this candidate is DEAD); (c) the per-scan lr lever is LOCALIZED with lr=3e-4 as the bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 BEST, beats lr=1e-3 above @iter-1 0.9501 and lr=1e-4 below @iter-5 0.9479 which over-anchors/under-fits). The ONLY remaining lever with a LIVE positive signal is the QUALITY of the warm-start anchor: iter-6 doubled pretrain_epochs 3->6 and lifted val 0.9541->0.9558 (+0.0017), the campaign's freshest gain. HYPOTHESIS (warm-start-anchor-quality-still-climbing): the per-scan Adam fit (no early-stop) is regularized by anchoring toward the GT-free amortized warm-start init; a BETTER-converged init is a better anchor, and iter-6 proved 6 epochs beats 3. If the init has not yet saturated at 6 epochs, pushing the amortized N2I pre-pass to 8 epochs (same shared cfg['lr']=3e-4 drives the pre-pass, solver lines 122 & 239) yields a still-more-generic, better-converged starting point, so each per-scan fit anchored near it should lift val above 0.9558. If instead the warm-start has already converged by ep6, val stays flat -- which localizes the init-quality saturation point and tells iter-8 the anchor lever is exhausted. EXACTLY ONE knob changes (pretrain_epochs 6->8). unet_c NOT touched (iter-3 + campaign-state ruled it out); n_iter NOT touched (iters 1-2 ruled it out); lr HELD at the iter-4/6 winner 3e-4. WALL <=15 min: iter-6 (pretrain=6) ran 792s; warm-start cost is ~58s/epoch (iter-4 pretrain=3 ran 617s -> iter-6 pretrain=6 ran 792s, +3 ep = +175s), so +2 ep ~= +117s -> ~909s ~= 15.2 min, capped by outer_wall_s=1500. This is the LARGEST single-knob warm-start push that respects the <=15 min six-box budget (6->12 would breach it at ~19 min). grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
